bullets.title: INTC +9-10% pre-mkt: Trump announces Apple-Intel US chip manufacturing deal
bullets.body: Trump tweeted at 00:29 ET that Apple agreed to work with Intel to design and build chips in America; Intel confirmed ramp production of its 18A-P node (9% better perf vs 18A). Multiple desks flagging this as catalyst with INTC trading +10% pre-open at ~$121. Deal reportedly based on a May preliminary agreement and fits geopolitical foundry diversification narrative.

bullets.title: AAPL: Price hikes unavoidable as DRAM/NAND up 600-900% since 2023; iPhone Pro ~$270 increase flagged
bullets.body: CEO Tim Cook confirmed memory/storage costs have become 'unsustainable' and Apple will raise product prices; AAPL is willing to use its balance sheet to boost memory supply but won't build its own fabs. WSJ analysis implies iPhone Pro could see ~$270 increase; Morgan Stanley forecasts 15% chip supply deficit through 2027. Memory stocks (SK Hynix, Samsung) rallied 4-6% on the commentary.

bullets.title: ACN -14%: FY26 revenue guide cut to 3-4%, bookings -3% y/y, Street sees negative FY27 organic growth
bullets.body: Accenture Q3 EPS $3.80 beat ($3.71 est) but revenue $18.72B missed $18.78B; FY26 growth guidance cut to 3-4% from 3-5% and Q4 guide $17.75-18.4B below $18.48B consensus. Bookings declined to $19.3B (-3% y/y) with managed services missing badly ($9.06B vs $11.32B est). Street now models negative organic growth for FY27; multiple de-rates to 15-year lows. ACN simultaneously announced ~$4.175B cybersecurity acquisitions (Dragos majority, runZero, NetRise) with $208M combined ARR growing 53% y/y.

bullets.title: INTU downgraded to Hold at Stifel; PT cut to $275 from $375 on expected growth target cuts
bullets.body: Stifel cuts INTU to Hold and slashes PT to $275 (2% upside) from $375 (39% upside), expecting the company to lower growth targets for TurboTax and GBS. FactSet consensus sits at $474 with a wide $275-921 range.

bullets.title: CRM upgraded to Buy at Monness with $200 PT (29% upside)
bullets.body: Monness, Crespi, Hardt upgrades Salesforce to Buy from Neutral with a $200 price target implying 29% upside from $155. Analyst Brian White cites valuation as the key consideration; FactSet average target is $248.

bullets.title: GOOGL: AI researcher Noam Shazeer leaves for OpenAI; Waymo recalls 3,800 robotaxis
bullets.body: Top Alphabet AI researcher Noam Shazeer (Gemini co-lead) is departing to join OpenAI as AI architecture lead, a notable talent loss. Separately, Waymo recalled over 3,800 robotaxis over a software flaw allowing vehicles to enter closed construction zones. Also, Morgan Stanley flags GOOGL's deal to rent 110K GPUs at ~$50/watt annually as bullish for GCP monetization, with 27% upside to MS growth estimates if GCP monetizes at $25/watt in 2027.

bullets.title: GOOGL/$50/watt GPU deal signals hyperscaler capex heading toward $1T in 2027; META neocloud upside
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley and MS EU Semis flagged GOOGL's ~110K GB300 GPU rental at $50/watt as a major signal: GCP/AWS monetization at $25/watt in 2027 would drive 27%/16% upside to MS growth estimates. META neocloud opportunity seen as larger-than-expected; 500MW at $30/MW could add $4+ to 2028 EPS. Implication: hyperscaler capex estimates for 2027 biased toward $1 trillion.

bullets.title: MRVL: KeyBanc raises PT to $385 on durable DC networking TAM; FY29E revs $25.6B
bullets.body: KeyBanc lifts MRVL PT from $260 to $385 (37x FY29E EPS of $10.31 vs consensus $8.89), arguing DC networking is a ~$30B ex-NVDA TAM by 2030. Scale-up networking ($13B by 2030) seen as more durable than custom XPUs; Celestial AI acquisition adds silicon photonics differentiation. FY29E revenue estimate of $25.6B well above Street's $22.7B.

bullets.title: JPM raises WFE 2026 forecast to +28% YoY ($155B); 2027 to +29% ($200B) on AI capex surge
bullets.body: JPMorgan lifts CY2026 WFE growth forecast from 21% to 28% YoY and CY2027 from 18% to 29%, driven by top-4 US CSPs growing capex ~80% YoY in 2026 and ~50% in 2027. China AI data center capex forecast to double to $95-151B by 2029. DRAM, TSMC, INTC/Samsung foundry, and YMTC cited as largest absolute-dollar WFE upside sources.

bullets.title: SHOP: Spring 2026 Editions reinforce AI commerce platform; JPM reiterates OW, $150 PT
bullets.body: JPM maintains Overweight on Shopify ($150 PT, ~22x 2027E gross profit of $8.6B), highlighting Spring Editions AI momentum: Catalog API converting AI searches 2x higher vs scraped data, Shop Pay extended to non-Shopify brands accessing 250M+ shoppers, and Campaign Autopilot enabling AI-powered ad campaigns across FB/IG/MSFT/SNAP/ChatGPT channels. Jefferies also flagged SHOP as benefiting from AI-driven commerce take-rate expansion.

bullets.title: SNOW: Databricks $6.9B ARR run-rate (+80% YoY) poses growing competitive threat
bullets.body: Databricks' Data+AI Summit showed $6.9B ARR (F1H27 run-rate, 80% growth, 65% core ex-tokens), $1B+ ahead of Snowflake, with new launches (LTAP architecture, CustomerLake CDP, Genie agentic coworker, Panther SIEM) directly competing across Snowflake's core workloads. Citi sees positive read-throughs for MSFT and PLTR; $10M+ ARR customers doubled to ~80 YoY. Enterprise migrations off Snowflake to Databricks cited by multiple sources.

bullets.title: MSFT: Building large AI model business selling to Chinese firms; ByteDance spending $1B+/yr on Azure
bullets.body: Bloomberg reports Microsoft has built a significant AI business selling OpenAI models via Azure to Chinese tech firms including ByteDance ($1B+/yr), Ant Group, Meituan, and Tencent. OpenAI has privately complained to Microsoft about insufficient model-copying safeguards.

bullets.title: ADSK: BNP Paribas Exane initiates Outperform with $295 PT (53% upside)
bullets.body: BNP Paribas Exane initiates Autodesk at Outperform with a $295 target implying 53% upside from $193; FactSet consensus stands at $322 with a $235-456 range. PTC initiated Neutral at $130 (11% upside).

bullets.title: TLN: Goldman Sachs initiates Buy, $499 PT; CEG initiated Neutral at $305
bullets.body: GS initiates Talen Energy at Buy (12m PT $499), citing a long-term AWS PPA that de-risks cash flows and structural supply-demand tightening in PJM supporting elevated capacity prices. Constellation Energy initiated at Neutral ($305 PT) as premium valuation already reflects nuclear scarcity value and Calpine synergies.

bullets.title: MU: Next major catalyst June 24 earnings; consensus $20.57 EPS, $35.56B revenue
bullets.body: JPM flags MU earnings on June 24 as the next major market catalyst for semis. Consensus stands at $20.57 EPS and $35.56B revenue. Context: Apple's price hike commentary on memory costs and SK Hynix shipping HBM4E samples are supportive demand signals; Chinese buyers shifting toward domestic CXMT/YMTC is a headwind to watch.

bullets.title: DELL: Wolfe maintains Peer Perform; values at 17x CY28E EPS, above 10x historical avg
bullets.body: Wolfe Research maintains Peer Perform on Dell, acknowledging strong AI server execution and supply constraint tailwinds into FY28 but flagging valuation at 17x CY28E EPS ($24.25) vs. 10x historical average. Key risk: heavy memory pricing exposure means declining DRAM/NAND prices would compress both sales and margins.

bullets.title: PSKY/WBD: China antitrust clears Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. transaction
bullets.body: Paramount Skydance received unconditional Chinese regulatory clearance on June 17, following DOJ closing its investigation June 12 and Spanish FDI approval June 11. WBD up 0.9% on the news. Transaction nearing completion of regulatory approvals.

bullets.title: KeyBanc CIO survey: IT budget growth below 3.5% in 2026-27; CRM, ADBE, NOW, ORCL in bottom six net-change slots
bullets.body: KeyBanc 2026 CIO survey flags slowing IT spend (below 3.5% growth in 2026, further deceleration in 2027) with 34.5% of CIOs planning to reduce legacy software spend in favor of AI-native alternatives. Enterprise apps (Salesforce, Adobe, Workday, ServiceNow, SAP) predicted to land in bottom-six net-change buckets, reversing 2H25 strength. Security budgets expected to nearly double to 6%+; AI to consume 6%+ of 2026 IT budgets.

bullets.title: Retail investor flows: $7.9B on June 17, led by NVDA (+$567M), GOOGL (+$300M), MSFT (+$265M) in Mag 7
bullets.body: JPM retail radar shows single-stock purchases at 91st percentile activity on June 17 ($3.1B single-stock, $4.8B ETF). Top single-stock buys: NVDA +$567M, GOOGL +$300M, MSFT +$265M, TSLA +$187M; AAPL was a net sell (-$40M). Tech and Comms ETFs (SOXX, VGT, SMH) saw sustained buying; Momentum ETF inflows near 1-year highs.

bullets.title: Hawkish FOMC: 9 members project 2026 hike; markets pricing full hike by October; core PCE revised to 3.3%
bullets.body: Fed held at 3.5-3.75% but Chair Warsh dropped forward guidance, shortened the statement, and announced 5 reform task forces. Nine of 18 participants project at least one 2026 hike; median 2026 core PCE revised to 3.3% (from 2.5% in December). Markets now price a full hike by October and 45bp+ by spring 2027. MS holds base case of no hike (own PCE forecast 3.0%); JPM flipped tactically bullish on Iran deal relief.
